relations.crafted: made from a recipe at a crafting station (or by hand)
relations.built: placed with the Hammer from materials; near_station must be within range
relations.bought_from: Coins → trader → item; available_after = boss or Hildir's returned chest
relations.upgrades_station: station → upgrade (built with the Hammer next to it)
relations.used_in: explicit reverse links: craft, upgrade (quality 2+), build, fuel, process, summon, tame_food, forge_of_potential, obliterator, plant
relations.alt_recipes: additional ways to make the item (other station or input)
relations.console_only: true = exists only via console commands; kept in its nominal biome with no links
relations.found_in_structure: structure → item: the item can be found at a world structure (type 'structure'). Source object {found_in_structure, via, container, amount, chance, structure_lane, audit_source}; via = chest (loot chest/barrel, chance per roll), pickable (lying there to pick up; 'one of' spots give one item of a group), container (breakable loot container such as Dvergr crates, muddy scrap piles, meat piles, flesh mounds, bee nests), mined (resource node that is part of the structure) or miniboss_drop (dropped by the structure's miniboss, e.g. Hildir's chests); via = spawn is used on creatures for structure spawns (e.g. Draugr ← Draugr Village)
relations.spawns: structure → creature: creatures that spawn at/in the structure (structure.spawns[], with per-variant spawner counts and chances)
relations.unlocks: key item → structure it opens (used_in relation 'unlocks', e.g. Swamp Key → Sunken Crypts)
relations.structure_fields: structure items carry: spawns, chests (container, rolls, placement per prefab, loot with amount and chance per roll/per chest), pickables, containers, destructibles (not linked), requirements, vegvisir, miniboss_drops, prefabs, per_world, layout, aliases
